{{Article header|eyebrow=EDFM // Field Procedure|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]]'s Engineer services at Trophy Camp in Wolf 397.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Tod McQuinn's whereabouts are '''common knowledge'''.
* '''Invitation:''' Earn '''more than 15 bounty vouchers'''.
* Earn '''more than 15 bounty vouchers'''.
* Provide Tod with '''100,000 CR worth of bounty vouchers''' through the Engineer unlock interface.
}}
== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Earn '''more than 15 bounty vouchers'''.
# Hold at least '''100,000 CR worth of bounty vouchers''' for Tod's unlock.
# Travel to '''Trophy Camp''' in Wolf 397.
# Provide Tod with '''100,000 CR worth of bounty vouchers''' through the Engineer unlock interface.
# Enter the Engineer workshop and begin increasing your reputation with Tod.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
